description: List the analysis engines this build registers (the ListEngines RPC, as the CLI's -engines does): each with the questions it answers (evaluate, outcomes, holds, sensitive, satisfiable, sweep, compute), the strongest evidence it can produce, the bounds it takes, and whether it can run here. The names are what the verification tools' `engine` argument takes; empty there means auto. With `probe` each external engine is started once and checked against its manifest, as `sysml -engines -probe` does. The result is the ListEnginesResponse as protojson writes it.

probe.description: start each external engine's process once and check its handshake against its manifest, reporting the outcome as its status (sysml -engines -probe); false starts nothing

name: list_engines
